description: Source code for the ColumnChartRenderer class, which handles rendering of column charts in the PDFsharp charting library, including initialization, layout, and drawing methods.

classes.name: ColumnChartRenderer
classes.description: Renderer class for column charts, managing initialization, layout, and drawing of column chart elements.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer-specific info including chart, axes, legend, plot area, and data labels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates layout and space for the chart components.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Renders the entire column chart including legend, plot area, axes, and data labels.

methods.name: GetPlotAreaRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific plot area renderer based on chart type.

methods.name: GetYAxisRenderer
methods.description: Returns the specific Y axis renderer based on chart type.

methods.name: InitSeriesRendererInfo
methods.description: Initializes data for rendering all series in the chart.

methods.name: InitSeries
methods.description: Sets up line and fill formats for each series and initializes point renderers.
